images.caption: The Law Library is in De Hoogt, in the very centre of Utrecht. As the name indicates, the main part of the library consists of law books, though there're also books on economics. Indeed, the Departments of Law, Economics and Governance of Utrecht University belong to the same faculty.

images.caption: The Dom Tower in Utrecht, the Netherlands is one of the best known landmarks of this country. This gothic tower is the highest church tower (112,5 metres/368 feet) in the Netherlands and was built between 1321 and 1382 as part of the Cathedral of St. Martin. The resolution of the original photograph is 7768*4150.

images.caption:
Map of the Utrecht tram system as of 2022. It features:
currently operating tram lines 20, 21, 22 (w:en:Utrecht sneltram)
the former Gemeentetram Utrecht tram network as of 1936 (Source: „Utrecht 1936“ on the Tundria website (accessed 10 May 2020), File:Gemeentetram Utrecht LIJNENNET 1908.jpg)
the former Nederlandsche Buurtspoorweg-Maatschappij interurban tram line Utrecht–Zeist as of 1936 (Source: „Utrecht 1936“ on the Tundria website)
the former Houten tram line
railway stations in the Utrecht area
It was updated on 4 September 2022 with the changes to the system that happened in July 2022: routes 60 and 61 were renumbered 20 and 21, as well as extended to P+R Science Park.
